verifications.claim: The 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers are underway.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly states that qualification is already underway.

verifications.claim: 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers are scheduled through 2025 across all confederations.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The European Qualifiers for the 2026 FIFA World Cup ran from March to November 2025; remaining 35 berths will be decided by March 2026, with qualifiers through 2025.
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm main qualification phases across confederations run through 2025, though play-offs extend to 2026; 'through 2025' is accurate.

verifications.claim: UEFA matches for the 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifiers continue in March 2025.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: The European Qualifiers for the 2026 FIFA World Cup ran from March to November 2025; Matchday 1 21–22 March 2025.
verifications.reasoning: March 2025 marks the start (Matchday 1), not a continuation after prior matches; phrasing 'continue' is broader than precise start.

verifications.claim: The final two UEFA spots for the 2026 FIFA World Cup will be determined in a play-off tournament in March 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: play-offs for the remaining finals places taking place in March 2026; four path winners qualified; 16 UEFA berths... 12 group winners + Bosnia, Czechia, Sweden, Türkiye.
verifications.reasoning: Play-offs determine final 4 UEFA spots (12 group winners + 4 play-off winners), not 2.

verifications.claim: UEFA European Qualifiers Matchday 1 is on 21–22 March 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: MATCHDAY 1 Friday 21 March 2025... Saturday 22 March 2025; Matchday 1 21–22 March 2025.

verifications.claim: Wales vs. Kazakhstan is scheduled for March 24–25, 2025 in UEFA European Qualifiers.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: Saturday 22 March 2025 J Wales 3-1 Kazakhstan; Matchday 2: J Liechtenstein 0-2 Kazakhstan, North Macedonia 1-1 Wales (no Wales vs Kazakhstan on 24-25).
verifications.reasoning: Match occurred on 22 March 2025, not 24–25 March.

verifications.claim: Moldova vs. Norway is scheduled for March 24–25, 2025 in UEFA European Qualifiers.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: Saturday 22 March 2025 I Moldova 0-5 Norway; Tuesday 25 March I Moldova 2-3 Estonia (no Moldova vs Norway on 24-25).
verifications.reasoning: Match occurred on 22 March 2025, not 24–25 March.

verifications.claim: Israel vs. Estonia is scheduled for March 24–25, 2025 in UEFA European Qualifiers.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: Saturday 22 March 2025 I Israel 2-1 Estonia; Tuesday 25 March I Moldova 2-3 Estonia (no Israel vs Estonia on 24-25).
verifications.reasoning: Match occurred on 22 March 2025, not 24–25 March.

verifications.claim: UEFA European Qualifiers Group Stage continues on June 6–7, 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: MATCHDAY 3 Friday 6 June 2025... Saturday 7 June 2025; Matchday 3 6–7 June 2025.
verifications.reasoning: Exact dates for Matchday 3 group stage matches.

verifications.claim: Concacaf Qualifiers Second Round matches are continuing for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Second Round matches listed from March 2024 through June 2025 (e.g., 04 June 2025, 06 June 2025).
verifications.reasoning: Sources detail ongoing Second Round matches into mid-2025.

verifications.claim: The play-off tournament finals for the 2026 FIFA World Cup are in March 2026.

verifications.evidence: Play-off finals Tuesday 31 March 2026; Play-Off Tournament... in March 2026.
